title: Polish decision
description: One conservative Language Polish execution record (AES-V2.18 / SUE-610). Full contract for the KEEP / LOCAL_POLISH / UPSTREAM_REPLAN_REQUIRED action classes, the pairwise gate, the accept rule, and edit-surface observability: docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §11–§14. This record executes INSIDE the ceiling a schemas/delta-plan.schema.json record already set (docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §15); it never computes or widens that ceiling. KEEP is a first-class SUCCESS state, not a failure or a no-result — a draft that already satisfies the target is not a shortfall to be corrected by finding something, anything, to change. There is no aggregate here either: no total, average, weighted distance, or overall score anywhere in this record except `edit_surface.original_total` / `edit_surface.changed_total`, which are counts of a measurement unit (characters or sentences), not a quality figure — see the no-aggregate guard in scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs.

language.description: BCP-47 tag for the language this decision was made against, e.g. ko-KR.

pack_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the governing editorial/profiles/language/<tag>.json pack, or null when no pack yet governs this language.

delta_plan_ref.description: The delta_plan_id this decision executes inside the ceiling of. A polish decision with no delta plan behind it has no authorized ceiling to stay inside.

basis.description: explicit_human_feedback: the human made or confirmed this decision. model_inference: an agent judged it. Reused from schemas/reference-evaluation.schema.json and schemas/feedback-record.schema.json.

action.description: KEEP is a first-class SUCCESS state, not a failure or a no-result (LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §11). LOCAL_POLISH means at least one candidate edit survived the pairwise gate. UPSTREAM_REPLAN_REQUIRED means this draft's gap is not a polish-scale problem and must route to the layer named in upstream_route.

edits.description: Candidate edits considered. May be empty for KEEP. Guards P1–P6 (scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs) tie action, application_mode, and verdict together — this schema only fixes shape.

upstream_route.description: Non-null and naming the owning layer plus a reason exactly when action is UPSTREAM_REPLAN_REQUIRED (guard P3); null otherwise.

layer.description: An editorial/feedback-routing.json layer id, resolved dynamically by scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs — never hardcoded here.

authority_class.description: Same vocabulary as schemas/language-pack.schema.json's $defs.authority_class — an edit inherits its authority class from the rule it executes, or is assigned one directly for a defect found with no rule behind it.

application_mode.description: Same five values as schemas/language-pack.schema.json rules[].application_mode (docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §12). Carried directly on the edit — not resolved by re-reading the pack — so a decision record is self-contained and auditable without cross-referencing the pack version that was active when it was made.

pairwise.description: The eleven fixed criteria (LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §13), judged against ORIGINAL (the incumbent span, not "before" — ORIGINAL is simply the other option the gate is choosing between). Polarity note: for repetition, over_explication, stiffness, and information_loss, `better` means the AFTER span has LESS of it — these four are named after defects, not after qualities. All eleven are OPTIONAL in this schema; completeness is enforced by scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs per guard P4 (a soft_detector edit must carry all eleven) and P6 (a hard_local_correction edit may carry only semantic_integrity).

repetition.description: better means the AFTER span has LESS repetition than ORIGINAL.

over_explication.description: better means the AFTER span has LESS over-explication than ORIGINAL.

stiffness.description: better means the AFTER span has LESS stiffness than ORIGINAL.

information_loss.description: better means the AFTER span has LESS information loss than ORIGINAL.

rule_ref.description: The language-pack rule id this edit executes, or null for a defect found with no rule behind it (e.g. an exact-quotation mismatch caught by an integrity check rather than a pack rule).

defect.description: What was actually observed in ORIGINAL — the concrete defect this candidate edit addresses, not a restatement of the rule it came from.

verdict.description: accept only when the accept rule (LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §13, guards A1–A3) holds — enforced by scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs as an ERROR, not a warning, when violated. Otherwise revert, and ORIGINAL stands. Ambiguity reverts.

revert_reason.description: Required when verdict is revert (enforced by scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs) — which clause of the accept rule failed, or why the candidate could not be shown to satisfy it.

edit_surface.description: How much of the original text changed, in characters or sentences — recorded so a broad rewrite is visible as a broad rewrite (LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §14). ADVISORY_EDIT_SURFACE_BAND = 0.20 is declared once in scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs. Crossing it does not fail the draft — it is not a gate — it requires large_edit_justification to be non-empty, enforced by scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs, never by this schema.

original_total.description: A count of the measurement unit, not a quality figure — exempted from the no-aggregate property-name guard for exactly that reason (see scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs).

changed_total.description: A count of the measurement unit, not a quality figure — exempted from the no-aggregate property-name guard for exactly that reason (see scripts/lib/delta-core.mjs).

large_edit_justification.description: Required (non-empty) when changed_total / original_total exceeds ADVISORY_EDIT_SURFACE_BAND (0.20). Names the concrete defect that justified editing that much of the text, and states whether UPSTREAM_REPLAN_REQUIRED was considered instead. The band triggers an explanation, never a rejection of the draft (LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §14).
